content:
- Final boundary review passed: verifier is a single DB module, CLI is thin, schema/model facts are not duplicated.
- Marked task-6 completed with passes true and checked off acceptance criteria.
- Ran .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; it updated current/done summaries and task history.
- Verification evidence: make check passed, make test passed, make lint passed, make test-long passed against live SyncFeed.
- Next: git add all, commit with task finished message, push, then quit.

- Choose-Task startup read previous progress and active task summaries.
- No .ralph/tasks/bugs directory exists, so there are no active bug tasks to select.
- Scanned active Story 3/4/5 task files for <priority> and <blocked_by>; none were present.
- All active candidates are unblocked <passes>false</passes> tasks with no explicit priority tags.
- Selected Story 3 Task 1 because it is the first logical unblocked failing task in the API story chain and creates the HTTP/OpenAPI foundation required by later read, document, and search API work.
- Next: write .ralph/tasks/story-3-http-api/task-1-add-http-server-and-openapi.md to .ralph/current_task.txt and quit immediately.

- Read progress, tdd skill, improve-code-boundaries skill, current_task.txt, and Story 3 Task 1.
- Task has no TO BE VERIFIED or NOW EXECUTE plan marker yet, so this is the planning branch.
- Next: inspect repo/API/database boundaries, write task plan under .ralph/tasks/story-3-http-api/task-1-add-http-server-and-openapi_plans/, update task with plan path and NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Inspected workspace manifests, Makefile, opentk-api, and opentk-db boundaries.
- Found opentk-api exists but only has a placeholder lib.rs and no dependencies yet; workspace already pins axum, sqlx, tokio, serde, thiserror, clap, tracing.
- Boundary decision for plan: keep HTTP router/config/error DTOs in opentk-api and add reusable PostgreSQL pool initialization in opentk-db so SQLx setup is not duplicated in API bootstrap.
- Next: add plan file and update Story 3 Task 1 with plan path and NOW EXECUTE marker.

- Created .ralph/tasks/story-3-http-api/task-1-add-http-server-and-openapi_plans/http-server-openapi-plan.md.
- Plan specifies typed API config, router/openapi constructors, consistent JSON error shape, DB pool boundary in opentk-db, and vertical TDD slices.
- Updated Story 3 Task 1 with the plan path and NOW EXECUTE marker.
- Per task instructions, quit immediately now; next agent should read NOW EXECUTE and implement the plan with tdd + improve-code-boundaries.

- Resumed Story 3 Task 1 in NOW EXECUTE state.
- Read required tdd and improve-code-boundaries skill files plus .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next: read task plan, inspect current API/DB workspace structure, then execute vertical TDD slices.

- Began RED 1 for Story 3 Task 1.
- Added crates/opentk-api/tests/health.rs with an integration test for GET /health using a real PgPool and public opentk_api::router.
- Running cargo test -p opentk-api health_reports_ok_when_database_is_reachable to capture the expected red failure.

- RED 1 failed as expected: missing axum/sqlx/serde_json/tokio/tower deps and missing opentk_api::router.
- Added initial opentk-api dependencies and minimal router with GET /health doing SELECT 1 through PgPool.
- Running cargo test -p opentk-api health_reports_ok_when_database_is_reachable for GREEN 1.

- GREEN 1 direct cargo test compiled but failed because OPENTK_TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL was unset outside the repo Postgres harness.
- Switching per-slice test runs to ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh so Postgres env matches make test.

- GREEN 1 passed through ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-api health_reports_ok_when_database_is_reachable.
- Added RED 2 test crates/opentk-api/tests/openapi.rs for GET /openapi.json through public router.
- Running the OpenAPI slice test now; expected failure is 404/missing route.

- RED 2 failed as expected with 404 for /openapi.json.
- Checked current crate index: utoipa latest shown by cargo search is 5.4.0.
- Added utoipa workspace dependency, generated ApiDoc from Rust path/schema annotations, and served /openapi.json from router.
- Running OpenAPI slice test for GREEN 2.

- GREEN 2 passed through ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-api openapi_document_is_served_from_router.
- Added RED 3 crates/opentk-db/tests/database_connection.rs for opentk_db::connect(DatabaseConfig) returning a queryable PgPool.
- Running the DB connection boundary slice test now; expected failure is missing connect/DatabaseConfig exports.

- RED 3 failed as expected: opentk_db::connect and DatabaseConfig were missing.
- Added crates/opentk-db/src/database.rs with DatabaseConfig, DatabaseError, and connect using PgPoolOptions.
- Re-exported the DB boundary from opentk-db root and running the connection test for GREEN 3.

- GREEN 3 first run hit linker failure for existing opentk-db bin complete-sync object file: ld could not find target/debug/deps/complete_sync-...rcgu.o.
- This was not a Rust compile/type/test failure in the new database boundary; rerunning focused DB test once to distinguish transient build artifact issue from repeatable failure.

- GREEN 3 passed on rerun through ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-db connect_returns_pool_that_can_query_postgres.
- Added RED 4 crates/opentk-api/tests/startup.rs for ApiConfig/build_app preserving bind address and connecting router to configured database URL.
- Running startup slice test now; expected failure is missing ApiConfig/build_app.

- RED 4 failed as expected: missing opentk_api::ApiConfig and build_app.
- Added ApiConfig, ApiServer, ApiError, build_app, serve, and opentk-api binary.
- API startup now delegates pool creation to opentk-db::connect with typed DatabaseConfig.
- Running startup slice test for GREEN 4.

- GREEN 4 passed through ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-api api_config_builds_router_connected_to_configured_database.
- Added RED 5 health test for consistent JSON error shape when database health query fails.
- Running error-shape slice now; expected failure is panic/500/non-matching body from current health handler.

- RED 5 failed as expected: /health panicked on PoolTimedOut instead of returning JSON error.
- Added ErrorResponse, ApiError::DatabaseUnavailable, IntoResponse mapping to 503 JSON, and OpenAPI 503 schema annotation.
- Shortened unreachable-pool acquire timeout in the test to keep the error path deterministic.
- Running error-shape slice for GREEN 5.

- GREEN 5 first run hit build artifact error creating target/debug/deps/libopentk_api-...rlib: failed to open object file No such file or directory.
- No Rust diagnostic was emitted. Rerunning focused error-shape test once as with the previous transient linker artifact.

- GREEN 5 passed through ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-api health_returns_json_error_when_database_is_unreachable.
- Boundary cleanup: API health/openapi tests now use opentk_db::connect instead of duplicating raw PgPoolOptions setup.
- CLI cleanup: DATABASE_URL fallback now reports NotPresent/NotUnicode explicitly instead of using .ok().
- Running cargo fmt --check before full verification.

- cargo fmt --check failed only on rustfmt formatting in crates/opentk-api/src/bin/opentk-api.rs attribute layout.
- Running cargo fmt before required make verification gates.

- cargo fmt completed.
- Starting required make check gate (fmt --check + clippy workspace all targets with -D warnings).

- make check failed on clippy::missing_errors_doc for opentk_db::connect.
- Added # Errors docs for opentk_db::connect and proactively for opentk_api::build_app/serve.
- Rerunning make check.

- make check failed on clippy::doc_markdown for PostgreSQL/SQLx in new Database docs.
- Added backticks in DB docs and preemptively fixed PostgreSQL/Axum mentions in API docs.
- Rerunning make check.

- make check failed on clippy::needless_for_each emitted by utoipa OpenApi derive macro.
- Removed OpenApi derive and path attributes; openapi() now builds typed utoipa OpenApi structs directly with schemas generated from ToSchema DTOs.
- Rerunning make check.

- make check stopped at fmt after the OpenAPI builder rewrite.
- Running cargo fmt and will rerun make check.

- cargo fmt completed after OpenAPI builder rewrite.
- Rerunning required make check gate.

- make check passed after replacing utoipa OpenApi derive with typed OpenAPI builder code.
- Starting required make test gate; not running make test-long because this is not a story-ending/e2e-required task.

- make test passed. New API tests passed: health success/error, OpenAPI route, startup config; new DB connection test passed.
- Existing long-only SyncFeed smoke remained ignored in default suite as expected.
- Starting required make lint gate explicitly, even though make check already passed the same lint lane.

- make lint passed explicitly.
- Starting final improve-code-boundaries review: checking diff and searching for stale placeholder text, swallowed .ok(), old health panic, and duplicate PgPoolOptions setup in API/DB boundary.

- Final boundary review found new API/DB path clean: API owns HTTP/OpenAPI/CLI, DB owns pool setup, no placeholder API text remains.
- Review found pre-existing swallowed errors in crates/opentk-db/src/bin/complete-sync.rs (.ok on DATABASE_URL) and crates/opentk-db/src/sync_state.rs (.to_std().ok()).
- Created .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-remove-swallowed-env-and-duration-errors.md per repo policy.
- Marked Story 3 Task 1 acceptance criteria complete and set passes true; make check/test/lint all passed, make test-long intentionally not run per task rule.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, add all files, commit, push, then quit.
